gemini.title: Table Uv101b Usual Resident Population By Sex By Age Datazone
gemini.abstract: Table Uv101b Usual Resident Population By Sex By Age Datazone is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It contains records relating to table uv101b usual resident population by sex by age datazone.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
